Both feature white click wheels with standard playback icons and LCD screens displaying music library menus with artist names.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific model generation and verify the image aligns with the 'iPod' class label at a high confidence level.
To rigorously audit the legibility and semantic correctness of the text on the displays, a common failure point for AI generation.
To ensure the circular geometry of the click wheels is perfect and not elliptical or warped, and that boundaries between buttons are sharp.
To check for subtle lighting inconsistencies or texture anomalies on the metallic/plastic surfaces.

Geometric perfection of circular click wheels

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text on the screens. AI often generates gibberish or inconsistent fonts.
